small_guidance:
- Autotune `conv_kernel` over `BLOCK_M ∈ {64,128,256}`, `BLOCK_N ∈ {32,64}`, `num_warps ∈ {4,8}`, `num_stages ∈ {2,3}`; current 256/64/8w may be over-tiled for OC=64 (only one BLOCK_N tile) — try BLOCK_N=32 to enable two parallel OC tiles per N.
- In `gn_apply_lse_online_kernel`, sweep `BLOCK_S ∈ {256, 512, 1024}` with `num_warps ∈ {4,8}` and `num_stages ∈ {2,3}`; the static_range over C=64 plus per-iter loads of mean/invstd/gamma/beta dominates — preload all 64 mean/invstd/gamma/beta into registers once before the loop.
- Cache the per-channel folded scale `gamma*invstd` and shift `beta - mean*gamma*invstd` into small constexpr-sized vectors (size C) loaded once per program to remove the inner-loop scalar loads.
large_guidance:
- Fuse conv directly into the GN-stats pass: one program per (N, group) computes conv outputs for its CH_PER_GROUP channels over all S, accumulating sum and sumsq on the fly — eliminates the full N*OC*S writeback/readback of x_conv (the dominant memory traffic at 128×64×126×126).
- Then a second fused kernel recomputes conv (or reads x_conv) once and performs GN+tanh+hardswish+residual+LSE in a single pass with online logsumexp; alternatively keep x_conv materialized but compute it in channels-last layout so the LSE pass loads C=64 contiguously per spatial point.
- Consider implementing conv as an implicit-GEMM with `BLOCK_K = IC*KH*KW = 72` fully unrolled (small enough to fit in registers) and tile over (OC=64, S) with channels-last output so downstream kernels see contiguous channel reads.
